issue_request: FHIR-40705 is an Applied/Persuasive with Modification vocabulary issue asking to clarify http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/valueset-map by replacing the vague concept-map relevance wording with a description saying the concept map may help understand value set use and may supply translations used or intended for use with the value set.
initial_application: The Jira comment links HL7/fhir-extensions#120. Extension Pack commit d97f79ca36608f23471b0b224b75bfc9e892015d changed input/definitions/ValueSet/StructureDefinition-valueset-map.xml description and differential definition to the approved wording, and PR #120 merged on 2024-07-27. No core FHIR source commit applied the change because the active extension definition is not maintained in this core checkout.
additional_context: Core searches found no active fhir.ini profile/build entry or current StructureDefinition source for valueset-map or codesystem-map; core retains only canonical OID entries, an example valueset-map use, and historical generated release snapshots. Core history includes dd468d4f17 removing extension definitions from the R5 source. The Jira description also said the comment applied to CodeSystem, but PR #120 and the final resolution targeted the ValueSet valueset-map extension; the current Extension Pack codesystem-map definition still has the older value-set wording, and no separate applied codesystem-map Jira was found in this bounded check.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source file was changed because the authoritative valueset-map StructureDefinition lives in the FHIR Extension Pack and already has the approved ValueSet wording.
